name: sandbase-ai/cat-vton
description: CatVTON is a virtual try-on model. It dresses the person in a photo with a garment from a second image, with controls for the covered body area, guidance, steps, and aspect ratio.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description:
The same seed and the same input given to the same version of the model
            will output the same image every time.

cloth_type.title: Cloth Type
cloth_type.description:
Type of the Cloth to be tried on.

        Options:
        upper: Upper body cloth
        lower: Lower body cloth
        overall: Full body cloth
        inner: Inner cloth, like T-shirt inside a jacket
        outer: Outer cloth, like a jacket over a T-shirt

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance scale (CFG)
guidance_scale.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
            the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

readme:
# try-on

CatVTON virtual try-on: dress the person in `human_image_url` with the garment in `garment_image_url`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `3:2` / `4:3` / `5:4` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `3:4` / `2:3` / `9:16` | — | Output frame shape. |
| `guidance_scale` | number 0–20 | 2.5 | How strictly to follow the garment. |
| `num_inference_steps` | integer 1–50 | 30 | More steps add detail and time. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |
| `cloth_type` | `upper` / `lower` / `overall` / `inner` / `outer` | — | Which body area the garment covers. |
| `garment_image_url` | image URL | — | Photo of the garment. |
| `human_image_url` | image URL | — | Photo of the person. |

## Billing

$0.00125 per image.

| Request | Price |
|---|---|
| One image | $0.0013 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Use a front-facing person photo and a flat garment photo.
